title: Study Comparing Emergency Contraception Effectiveness in Women Who Weight ≥ 80 kg
brief_summary: The proposed research study is a Phase IIb, multi-center, single-blind, randomized study of UPA 30 mg, LNG 1.5 mg and LNG 3.0 mg to evaluate EC effectiveness in women with weight ≥ 80 kg who present within 72 hours of unprotected intercourse.
